summary.name: VictorOps (now Splunk On-Call)
summary.one_liner: VictorOps is an incident management and on-call alerting product, now renamed Splunk On-Call after its acquisition by Splunk.
use_cases: route context-rich alerts to on-call engineers
give stakeholders visibility into active incidents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VictorOps, which is now called Splunk On-Call following its acquisition by Splunk. It is aimed at developers, DevOps and operations teams that handle on-call duties. According to the page, it sends context-rich notifications so teams can collaborate across functions and resolve incidents faster. It also lets stakeholders see critical incidents and the steps taken to resolve them. The page itself is mostly a rebranding notice and gives few technical details.
notable: Renamed to Splunk On-Call after acquisition by Splunk
Stakeholder visibility into incident steps and status
caveats: Page is a rebranding notice with few product specifics
Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Listing mentions a blameless culture blog post, but the page text does not cover that topic
